subject.title: Mobile chat: code syntax highlighting and richer markdown rendering

question: Should OpenClaw accept the two open in-repo native mobile rendering PRs as the direction for code highlighting and tables, or choose a different renderer/dependency strategy first?
rationale: The issue asks for new user-visible native rendering behavior across iOS/shared and Android, and the implementation choices affect app performance, dependency/license policy, and cross-platform consistency.

options.title: Use the linked PRs as canonical candidates
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100207 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100217 as the platform-specific implementation path, requiring proof and fixes there before closure.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Pick one platform or one rendering feature to land first, then keep this issue open for the remaining mobile Markdown work.

options.title: Pause for a different renderer strategy
options.body: Hold both implementation PRs until maintainers choose a shared dependency, parser, or product policy for native mobile Markdown rendering.

recommendation.title: Use the linked PRs as canonical candidates
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100207 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100217 as the platform-specific implementation path, requiring proof and fixes there before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the issue and is carrying both linked implementation candidates, making him the clearest routing owner for the product-direction choice.
